name: wasp
description: Workspace-Aware Spec-based Publisher — an additive layer on top of the bee plugin. Ships /wasp:audit-prep + /wasp:bundle-audit-specs + /wasp:unify-audit-specs + /wasp:pollinate (multi-package monorepo aware, per-package change detection, registry/token/scope validation, ✅ live publish polling, SemVer-correct bumping) + /wasp:cross-pollinate (cross-repository cascade orchestration with dep-graph traversal, topo-sorted serial execution, and downstream dep-pin updates) + /wasp:master-pollinate (the tier-1 cross-CROSS-pollinate: cascades ACROSS a suite of workspaces and GitHub orgs, tracking the cross-workspace edges no single cross-pollinate.yml owns, with a Pantheonic role rule for deterministic Constructor fan-out, delegating each workspace's cascade back to cross-pollinate) + /wasp:health (16-check setup validation incl. dep-graph rendering drift) + /wasp:forensics (post-mortem analysis of failed runs with external-reality cross-check) + /wasp:debug (open-ended investigation entry point).
